title: Dealer directory
intro: Every dealership on the platform, whatever its verification or trading state. Verification is about documents; trading status is about whether they may sell today.

empty.title: No dealerships match
empty.hint: Clear the search, or widen the verification and trading filters.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load the dealer directory.
toast.actionFailed: The change could not be applied.

detail.title: Dealership
detail.subtitle: Profile, branches, team, package and stock.
detail.suspendedMeta: Suspended {{when}} by {{by}}. The dealership sees this reason.
detail.verificationHint: Whether their trade licence and TRN have been checked.
detail.tradingHint: Whether they may publish and sell on the platform right now.
detail.noStock: This dealership has no listings yet.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.description: This stops the dealership trading immediately. It does not change their verification status.
suspend.effectPause_one: Pauses their live stock: {{count}} listing stops showing to buyers at once.
suspend.effectPause_other: Pauses their live stock: {{count}} listings stop showing to buyers at once.
suspend.effectPublish: Blocks the dealership from publishing or renewing anything while suspended.
suspend.effectNotify: Notifies the dealership owners by email and in-app, with the reason below.
suspend.effectSessions: Their team stays signed in — only dealer actions are blocked, not the marketplace.
suspend.reasonPlaceholder: Write this for the owners to read — they will see it word for word.
suspend.reasonHint: Required, 3–{{max}} characters. Sent to the owners exactly as written.

reinstate.title: Reinstate {{name}}?
reinstate.description: This lets the dealership trade again and undoes the pause this suspension applied.
reinstate.effectRestore: Restores exactly the listings this suspension paused — stock they paused themselves stays paused, and anything that expired meanwhile is not brought back.
reinstate.effectPublish: Lets the dealership publish, renew and manage its stock again.
reinstate.effectNotify: Notifies the dealership owners that they are active again.
